name: Leadbelly
detailed_description:
In a future where humanity’s brains are harvested to power sentient AI tanks, one consciousness awakens. You are Leadbelly a disembodied mind encased in steel, fueled by fury and a burning question: Who put your brain in this jar?

Unleash Strategic Destruction

Leadbelly is a hand-drawn, narrative-driven deckbuilder where every decision counts. Build your deck from a growing arsenal of cards, each hand offering new tactical opportunities. Adapt to your enemies, exploit faction weaknesses, and unleash devastating combos as you blaze a trail of vengeance.

A Story-Fueled Campaign

Leadbelly isn’t just about survival, it’s about revenge. From scorched wastelands to electrified fortresses, each act culminates in a powerful boss battle guarding a piece of your past. With every victory, you peel back the layers of a mystery far bigger than you imagined.

An AI Companion with a Mind of Its Own

You’re not alone inside the steel shell of your prison. A quirky, unpredictable AI-buddy bot rides alongside you, offering tactical advice, cryptic insights, and maybe even a bit of friendship.

Upgrade Through Meta-Progression

Every failure is fuel for your comeback. Unlock new cards and relics that persist between runs. Fine-tune your deck to match your playstyle, and turn every scrap of experience into firepower.

Hand Drawn & Animated

From the grimy bolts of your tank to the haunting wastelands you roam, Leadbelly is fully hand-drawn and hand-animated by an industry veteran with AAA experience.

Are You the Machine or the Man Inside?

Your body is a weapon. Your mind is a mystery. And the world that turned you into this…

is going to burn.

short_description: Leadbelly is a narrative-driven roguelike deckbuilder. You are a brain trapped in a war tank, seeking vengeance. Battle multiple enemy factions, build your deck, and uncover the truth with your AI companion. Adapt, upgrade, and fight, because the ones who did this to you will pay.

  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8200, AMD Athlon XE BE-2300, Snapdragon X Elite
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5500 (Broadwell), AMD Radeon R5 Graphics (Kaveri)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
